maxJobs.title: Max Jobs
maxJobs.description: Maximum number of postings to save.

timeFilter.title: Time Filter
timeFilter.description: Keep postings published within this window (based on the posting date, not the crawl date).

workArrangement.title: Work Arrangement
workArrangement.description: Filter by arrangement. The API ignores its own filter params, so filtering happens inside the Actor.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Optional allow-list matched against each posting's countries and continents, case-insensitive (e.g. ['Europe', 'United Kingdom', 'Nigeria']). Leave empty for everywhere.

includeLocked.title: Include Locked (Early Access) Postings
includeLocked.description: Postings from the last ~2 days are paywalled ('early access'): they have no company name, no slug and no page to read. Off by default because the rows are unusable.

fetchDetails.title: Fetch Full Descriptions
fetchDetails.description: Read each emitted posting's page for the schema.org JobPosting block (full description, salary, applicant-location requirements). One extra request per saved job.

maxPages.title: Max API Pages
maxPages.description: Safety cap on API pages walked (25 rows each). The feed is newest-first, so the default is plenty for a week of postings.

requestDelaySecs.title: Request Delay (seconds)
requestDelaySecs.description: Pause between requests. The API drops connections under burst load; 1.5s is safe and keeps a 100-job run under a minute or two.
